notes.title: The Competition Begins!
notes.content:
[p]The moment our community has been waiting for is finally here! Now it's time to put your skills to the ultimate test.


[b]LEADERBOARDS ARE LIVE![/b] [/p][p]Submit your AI scripts and watch them battle for supremacy on our new competitive leaderboards! Every season crowns new champions, and with each major update, the competition resets, giving everyone a chance to claim their spot in the Hall of Fame.

[b]GOD CONTROLS UNLEASHED![/b]
Not ready to code? No problem! Our new God Controls let you intervene directly - declare wars, boost armies, or obliterate entire nations with divine power. Perfect for casual players who want immediate action and spectacular visual effects![/p][p][/p][p][b]VISUAL CHANGES[/b][/p][p]Watch nations battle with spectacular new conquest animations as colors sweep across the map![/p][p][/p][p][b]The competitive era of Observe begins NOW. Will you code your way to the top, or will you rule through divine intervention?[/b][/p]

notes.title: Diplomacy
notes.content:
[p]Hello.

This update focuses on diplomacy and some UI changes. Countries now have to declare war on each other. They can band together and fight against others by forming alliances. UI is now updated too.


Notes:[/p][p]-Added diplomacy.[/p][p]-Removed the music player (for now, there will be more UI changes soon and it will be likely re-added).[/p][p]-Changed all scripts to now use diplomacy functions, including our character AIs.[/p][p]-Unified country and region panels. You can find more info about countries by switching tabs.[/p][p]-Alliance map mode.[/p][p]-An alliance gets disbanded if it owns the whole world, forcing the game to end with only one country left.[/p][p]-Backwards compatibility for AI Scripts. It will auto-declare wars on your targets, but I highly recommend updating your scripts.[/p][p][/p][p]Moving forward, I am planning to add leaderboards and god controls to the game. [/p][p][/p][p]If you're a script creator, check here: [url="https://observe.fandom.com/wiki/Functions"]observe.fandom.com/wiki/Functions[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Also, please join our [url="https://discord.gg/2wCwSj5tJV"]Discord[/url] and help shape Observe's future[/p]

notes.title: Visuals and Balance
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

For the past month I was working on units update. After getting most of it done, I decided to scrap it as it wasn't a good fit for the game as a whole.

Although I had to get rid of most of it, some parts like region animations are still useful. So this update tries to make the wars look a bit more dynamic.

I also lowered casualties per battle.




[img src="https://i.imgur.com/orl2pgU.gif"][/img]



Next update I will be focusing on diplomacy. Countries no longer will be at war from the start. I am not 100% sure what else will be included in that update as I like to prototype and try out different things.


Thanks for your continued support![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: I just found a terrible bug that was introduced by the new graphics update. Region-clicking and thumbnail generation were terribly broken, but now has been fixed.

notes.title: Graphics & Performance
notes.content:
Hi. 

This new update focuses on map visuals and performance.

-Made the game more visually appealing.
-Performance improved by 50% (I was getting 100 FPS before, now its more like 160-ish on a full zoom out.


I have been making updates for non-stop for the last weeks as many of you may have noticed. The next big update I am working on will probably change how wars are fought entirely. The plan is to make armies spread out to each border. And have numbers visible on each border for more visual information. Not sure when this will come out, I am in prototyping phase. I think that one might take a while. But I will most likely update the game in some other ways while I am mainly working on that idea.

notes.title: Challenges & Achievements
notes.content:
As the title suggests, Observe now has achievements that can be unlocked through challenges. For now, I’ve only added five. Two programming challenges and three chatting challenges, such as "Quit Stallin’ Me" (where you must guide Stalin to conquer the world in under 10 minutes).

Changes:

-New challenge system

-Achievements added

-Minor bug fixes

-Chat panel now has auto-complete suggestions for country names

-Chat panel no longer requires you to type a country’s name if you’ve mentioned it before
(e.g. if you wrote "Germany attack Denmark," you can then say "Attack Sweden," and Germany will understand you're referring to it)

Let me know if you find the challenges fun, and feel free to share ideas for new challenges and achievements, I plan to add many more soon!

Thanks for being here!!!

notes.title: Chat Update
notes.content:
Observe now has a chat feature that you can use to control AI. This update comes with a scenario named "Civilizations". The scenario features some of the greatest empires that have ever existed, and you can send commands to them or just watch these characters vibe.

-Chat screen: 
You can write "Alexander attack Bismarck," and the Macedon Empire will start attacking Germany. You can command an AI to "focus on tech" or "focus on x tech." You can tell them to start recruiting more troops with "Recruit" or "Focus on recruit". And you can just use a command like "Genghis help," and they will tell you what you can ask them to do.

-MiniScript integration: 
You can create similar AIs to the ones already included. You can also just change the messages at the top of the included AIs and basically create your own characters.

-Now you can upload scenarios to the Workshop with scripts attached.
-You can now set a global AI script.
-It is now possible to set a global population number for empty provinces.
-There is now a text at the bottom of the screen that shows which countries have been destroyed.

Thanks for all the support! :)

notes.title: Ideologies
notes.content:
Ideologies now are a part of the game. You can edit and create ideologies in the editor. If you set a country's ideology in the editor, it won't be able to change it during the game. Each ideology can have a positive and negative bonuses.

-New "ideology" map mode.
-You can now load .ms scripts to the countries in the scenario editor.
-GetPathBetweenRegions now works globally, I also added a lot more functions that get more info about coastal zones, thus giving more info about supply network.
-Now in console you can use up arrow key to get the previous command.
-History Shuffle now has a "Population" field where you can set the population of each continent.
-Similarly, now you can set the "Population" of a country when editing or creating one. It changes the population of the regions with a weighted system.
-Now you can click on the country names on the "scoreboard" to jump to the capital of the corresponding country.
-Fixed some bugs.


Most of these improvements came as suggestions from our community on [url=https://discord.gg/wQBXFtck]Discord[/url]. I suggest that you should join our little community to suggest new features and report bugs.

Thanks for playing Observe:)

notes.title: QoL and Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Hi again, today I got some good people on Discord suggesting me some features like more console commands and tooltips for map modes, so I implemented them.

Then some bugs were brought to my attention and, I fixed them too.

If you'd like to report a bug or suggest a feature, I highly recommend you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/wQBXFtck]Discord[/url] :)

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.content:
Hi, I have been working on an update for a while now. It was mostly polishing but it also has important features like console.

-Made the map look a bit better
-Added hotkeys for almost anything
-Added more stats
-Added more tooltips
-Added more music
-Added another map mode
-Fixed a lot of bugs
-Fixed a latency issue between the "real" map and the "wraparound" map
-Changed the History Shuffle's algorithm to be crazier, it used to be a lot more rigid
-Made the AI Studio simulation a lot better, it used to be so that you couldn't really control the simulation that happened inside AI Studio.
-Added 3 example scripts.
-Added 250 countries for History Shuffle
-Made 2 new scenarios
-And most importantly, I added an in-game console. Now you can use "listen [countryname]" to listen to a script's debug information. You can also do "reload [countryname]" to reload a country's script.


Next: I will be adding ideologies to the game. They'll be of course, customizable. I am right now thinking about if every ideology should also have a negative impact or not.

If you want to help with your ideas, or if you have any issues with anything, consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/wQBXFtck]Discord.[/url]

Can't wait to hear your thoughts :) thanks for being here.
